hypothesis: Reordering the control flow to exact-admission-before-transfer can preserve every sealed door already known to TRUMP while failing unsupported cases closed earlier, without changing the semantics of any underlying carrier.

proof_obligations.P1_source_guard: Candidate must verify the preregistration bytes and must import, not rewrite, the sealed mechanism implementations.
proof_obligations.P2_admission_precedes_execution: No sealed mechanism may execute until its complete door-specific admission predicate is true.
proof_obligations.P3_direct_equivalence: For every positive control, routed result must agree with a direct invocation of the corresponding sealed mechanism on the same object.
proof_obligations.P4_legacy_preservation: Existing APMA Trinity Sovereign independent checker must remain PASS without modification.
proof_obligations.P5_fail_closed: Over-budget or unsupported connected mixed cases must return OPEN before any generic transfer, full-variable-cube search, or unauthorized carrier execution.
proof_obligations.P6_no_hidden_products: The router must not materialize a global Cartesian product or enumerate the full variable cube; it may only invoke work already admitted by the selected sealed carrier.
proof_obligations.P7_claim_ceiling: A PASS establishes only architectural control-flow equivalence/extension over already sealed scoped mechanisms; it adds no new SAT class and does not move the global APMA frontier.
